props.title: Pilot program architecture
props.description: Show the operating shape of the pilot before the buyer asks how success will actually be measured.

phases.title: Decision framing
phases.goal: Lock executive success criteria and boundary conditions.

phases.title: Operational embed
phases.goal: Put the workflow inside the actual team rhythm instead of a demo bubble.

phases.title: Proof handoff
phases.goal: Convert results into procurement-ready proof for the next committee.

props.title: Pricing controls
props.description: Prove the commercial model can be governed, not just sold.

controls.title: Usage guardrails
controls.description: Alert before overage patterns turn pilot goodwill into surprise billing.

controls.title: Approval lanes
controls.description: Define who can discount, who can extend terms, and who signs off on exceptions.

controls.title: Renewal triggers
controls.description: Tie commercial motion to adoption thresholds instead of calendar hope.

props.title: Regional rollout plan
props.description: Roll out by sponsor strength, readiness, and support coverage instead of blasting every market at once.

items.description: Baseline market with deepest support coverage and fastest feedback loop.
Launch after playbook localization and partner enablement are validated.
